versions.changelog:
Initial release of vvvv-debugging skill for setting up debugging in vvvv gamma C# node projects.

- Generates VS Code launch.json and tasks.json for vvvv gamma projects, supporting both source and DLL reference workflows.
- Automatically detects vvvv installations and suggests which version to use.
- Scans the workspace for relevant files, patches, and determines correct build workflow.
- Guides users through selection of launch configurations, test patches, and build modes.
- Supports multiple launch profiles including Debug, Release/Performance, and Attach-to-process.
- Provides debugging best practices and handles configuration extension for existing setups.
